title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Hardship Offer Calculation Sheet
content:
**The hardship offer.** On a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan), the hardship offer is the plan's maximum months per deferral or the plan's lifetime maximum less the months already deferred, whichever is lower. The offer is never more than the lifetime room and never below zero.

## Lines of the sheet

| Line | Figure | Source |
|---|---|---|
| A | Per-request cap | The plan's maximum months per deferral |
| B | Lifetime room | The plan's lifetime maximum months of hardship deferral, less the months already deferred |
| C | Lower figure | The lower of line A and line B |
| D | Hardship offer | Line C, never more than line B and never below zero |

The months already deferred are every deferred month on the account: the total of the months on every hardship deferral booked on that financing account. The plan's maximum months per deferral and its lifetime maximum are the plan's own hardship deferral limits.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures, not plan limits)

| Case | Line A | Lifetime maximum | Months already deferred | Line B | Line C | Line D |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| No deferral yet | 2 | 5 | 0 | 5 | 2 | 2 |
| Part of the lifetime used | 2 | 5 | 4 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Lifetime fully used | 2 | 5 | 5 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Plan without deferral | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

**Reading the result.** The hardship offer is a whole number of months. A borrower asking for the longest deferral available asks for the figure on line D.
